messages.author: Hallie Marsh <hallie.marsh@saltreed.example.test>
messages.text:
Hello all,

A reminder that the harbour's quarterly inspection is on Thursday 1 October. The quay and the harbour office are closed to visitors that day, and the harbour office asks us not to change any of its systems while the inspection runs.

Hallie

messages.author: Lev Zarechny <lev.zarechny@saltreed.example.test>
messages.text:
Hello Bertram,

From Beacon v2.3 we plan to send telemetry packets as CBOR instead of JSON. Does the RX-40 shore receiver with firmware 4.x parse CBOR? If not, what are our options?

Regards,
Lev Zarechny
Saltreed Harbourworks

messages.author: Bertram Fogg <bertram.fogg@fogbell.example.org>
messages.text:
Hi Lev,

RX-40 firmware 4.x reads JSON only, and CBOR is not on our plan before next year. What 4.2 and later do support is gzip-compressed JSON: set the encoding byte of the frame header to 1.

Best regards,
Bertram Fogg
Fogbell Instruments, support

> Does the RX-40 shore receiver with firmware 4.x parse CBOR? If not, what are our options?

messages.author: Lev Zarechny <lev.zarechny@saltreed.example.test>
messages.text:
Thank you, that is clear. We will look at gzip.

Lev

messages.author: Ines Calderwood <ines.calderwood@hollinmere.example.org>
messages.text:
Dear Mira,

One question from our harbourmaster before the pilot starts: should the Hollin Mere pilot cover the north basin as well, or only the main quay? The north basin has its own tide gauge, which may matter for your scheduler.

Kind regards,
Ines Calderwood
Harbour office, Port of Hollin Mere

messages.author: Mira Castellane <mira.castellane@saltreed.example.test>
messages.text:
Dear Ines,

Good question; we have not decided yet. I will discuss it with Priya and come back to you next week.

Mira
